title: Inventory service
issue: Finance says the sales report is wrong: revenue is too high and it claims almost every order was a priority order. Separately, the warehouse oversold glue during yesterday's flash sale.

bugs.summary: reserve() checks availability and then writes across awaits without serialisation, so concurrent orders oversell and lose updates.
tierFor uses find() on ascending tiers, so the lowest tier (0%) always wins.
Object.assign(DEFAULT_OPTIONS, options) mutates the shared defaults (and its tags array), leaking priority/bulk into later orders.
